registry.description: Wickedness is the comprehensive term for the condition and conduct of the person who has fundamentally departed from what is right — living by what is harmful, unjust, and ungodly. The Hebrew and Greek vocabulary spans harmful, unjust, and morally corrupt. Wickedness in Scripture is not merely bad behaviour but a settled orientation of the inner person away from God: the wicked person thinks and wants and chooses wrongly as a matter of character rather than accident. It is the spiritual condition that sin, left unaddressed, produces.
